payout_quote: HP CC364A $5.25, HP CC364X $11.25, HP C8543X $9.00, HP CE255A $5.25, HP CE255X $11.25, HP Q5945A $4.50, HP Q5942A $6.00 — per-cartridge buyback price list; inkjet cartridges up to $3.00 each. Minimum 10 cartridges (or $15.00 in trade-in value) to start; check mailed within approximately 30 days.
steps: Gather empty HP/Canon inkjet or toner cartridges (minimum 10 cartridges or $15 in trade-in value)
Use the site's Trade-in Estimate / price list to see what each cartridge is worth
Request the free prepaid UPS shipping label, pack cartridges tightly, and drop off at UPS
Cartridges are inspected; a check is mailed within approximately 30 days
catches: Per-cartridge values are small ($0.25–$11.25); you need a batch of 10+ cartridges or $15 in value to participate.
Only listed HP/Canon models pay; unlisted, damaged, or remanufactured cartridges may pay $0.
Payment is a mailed check within ~30 days of receipt — not instant, and value depends on inspection.
biggest_catch: Small per-cartridge payouts ($0.25–$11.25) with a 10-cartridge/$15 minimum batch and ~30-day mailed-check payment — worth it only if you already have empties stockpiled.
eligibility: Anyone in all 50 states with qualifying empty HP/Canon cartridges (individuals, schools, offices).
timing: Check mailed within approximately 30 days of cartridges being received and inspected.
